subject: Monorepo release risk acceptance & secrets control evidence
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexinsurance.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Cedar Ridge Assessments <audit@cedarridge.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: monorepo release controls and secrets rotation

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 scoping for Apex Insurance we need evidence that the following controls are enforced for releases originating from the monorepo:

- Branch protection and required reviewers for protected branches (policy and recent enforcement logs)
- CI gating (which pipeline jobs block merges, and recent job run IDs for a production release)
- Build attestation (signed provenance or artifact hash for the release 2027-02-10)
- Secrets lifecycle (rotation cadence, who approved last rotation, and proof of rotation execution)
- Change approval trail (who approved the release, timestamps, and if any emergency bypass occurred)

If you can provide a short narrative plus the artifacts (logs, attestations, diff of pipeline config, rotation spreadsheet or KMS report) that would be ideal. We're on a tight timeline and would appreciate anything you can deliver by EOD Tuesday 2027-02-16 PST.

If there are any expected gaps (e.g., legacy jobs not yet migrating to the new gating flow), please call them out so we can document compensating controls.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Assessor — Apex Insurance (external)

----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexinsurance.com>, Cedar Ridge Assessments <audit@cedarridge.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: monorepo release controls and secrets rotation

Thanks Priya — looping in Soojin and Vanessa to assemble artifacts.

So here's my proposed breakdown:
- Soojin: CI gating artifacts and build attestation (pipeline run IDs, artifact hashes, and the attestation PDF).
- Vanessa: Secrets lifecycle exports (rotation spreadsheet + KMS audit lines) and owner approvals.
- Me: Change approval trail & branch protection enforcement logs (GitHub admin audit + PR approval snapshots).

We anticipate a small gap for two legacy release jobs that still run outside the new gating policy; we'll document them and point to compensating monitoring.

Deadline acknowledged — aiming to deliver a zipped evidence bundle and a short summary narrative by Tue EOD PST. If there are any specific file formats you prefer (csv vs xlsx for rotation table, redacted vs full audit logs), let us know.

Aditya Rao
Director, Engineering (Security Controls)
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexinsurance.com>, Cedar Ridge Assessments <audit@cedarridge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: monorepo release controls and secrets rotation

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 11:03, Aditya Rao wrote:
> Thanks Priya — looping in Soojin and Vanessa to assemble artifacts.
>
> So here's my proposed breakdown:
> - Soojin: CI gating artifacts and build attestation (pipeline run IDs, artifact hashes, and the attestation PDF).
> - Vanessa: Secrets lifecycle exports (rotation spreadsheet + KMS audit lines) and owner approvals.
> - Me: Change approval trail & branch protection enforcement logs (GitHub admin audit + PR approval snapshots).

All right — attaching the first tranche. See attachments:
- build-attest_20270214.pdf (signed build attestation for artifact: sha256:3b7f...e2a)
- ci-config-diff.patch (diff showing gating jobs marked required in 2027-02-01 config change)

Notes:
- Pipeline run IDs for the 2027-02-10 release: job-run-98732, job-run-98733, job-run-98734 (these are recorded in the attestation PDF).
- The gating job "integration-blocker" checks unit tests + security-scan + image-policy; it prevented 3 merges in Feb where policy failures were present — logs included in the Drive link.

Limitations/expected gaps:
- Two older release flows (deploy-legacy-a, deploy-legacy-b) still publish artifacts from a separate Jenkins cluster; their runs are visible in the Jenkins audit but are not yet covered by the integrated attestation flow. We're documenting compensating controls: (1) nightly reconciliation job that compares artifact hashes; (2) alerting to the release Slack channel for manual approval.

I'll hand off the secrets rotation export to Vanessa; she has the KMS logs and approval record.

--
Sojin Lee
Staff Software Engineer, Release & CI
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@apexinsurance.com>, Cedar Ridge Assessments <audit@cedarridge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: Monorepo release controls and secrets rotation — delivery

Priya — delivering the evidence bundle per your checklist. Summary below plus links:

- Branch protection & PR approvals: exported GitHub enforcement logs (see Drive link) and PR snapshots showing required reviewers. No emergency bypasses recorded for the 2027-02-10 release.
- CI gating & build attestation: attached build-attest_20270214.pdf and ci-config-diff.patch; pipeline run IDs are included in the attestation. Gating job "integration-blocker" is enforced for protected branches; three prevented merges were captured in Feb as part of policy enforcement.
- Secrets lifecycle: attached secrets-rotation-plan.xlsx (rotation cadence, last rotation approver: Vanessa Ortiz, timestamp: 2027-01-28T03:14:23Z) and KMS audit exports are in the Drive link (redacted to omit irrelevant production secrets).
- Change approval trail: PR approval snapshots + our release checklist showing approvers and timestamps. For the two legacy jobs noted earlier, compensating controls are documented (nightly reconciliation and manual guardrails).

Deliverables: zipped evidence bundle (Drive): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Monorepo/Release-Traceability-2027-02
Jira ticket for follow-ups (SEC-1428): https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SEC-1428

If you'd like a redacted PDF summary for Apex's public compliance folder, we can produce that by EOD Thursday. Please confirm receipt and whether anything else is required for your SOC 2 scope.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Engineering (Security Controls)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: build-attest_20270214.pdf, ci-config-diff.patch, secrets-rotation-plan.xlsx
